name: FedEx Corporation
reason: Cyclical parcel network with 10y avg ROIC only 7.1% and EBIT margin stuck near 7%, now mid-transformation after the FedEx Freight separation and facing Amazon/USPS competition, so 5-10y earnings are hard to pin down.

name: Freddie Mac
reason: Common equity value hinges on a binary conservatorship-exit/recap outcome and mortgage credit, with EPS history near zero until 2025 (3.32) and the 0.8x NTM P/E reflecting senior-preferred/Treasury claims rather than earnings power.

name: Eversource Energy
reason: Regulated utility with 0/10 years of >=7% EPS growth (10y CAGR 5.4%), net debt/EBITDA 5.6x, rising share count and negative FCF conversion, so no route to 7%+ per-share growth.

name: CoreCivic, Inc.
reason: Private prisons with EPS down at a -5.6% 10y CAGR, earnings set by federal detention policy (credible political/regulatory threat) and net debt/EBITDA 3.6x.

name: Cathay General Bancorp
reason: Efficient but ordinary spread-dependent lender concentrated in commercial real estate; EPS fell 18.7% in 2024 with the rate cycle and consensus FY2-3 growth is ~7%, with no clear specialness.

name: Buckle, Inc.
reason: Teen apparel retailer with 1.5% 10y revenue CAGR and fashion-driven earnings (EPS 2.03-5.16 range) that can't be forecast 5-10 years out despite a clean balance sheet.

name: Mohawk Industries, Inc.
reason: Commodity-like flooring maker tied to the housing/remodel cycle with EBIT margin at the 9th percentile of its history, a -1.3% 10y EPS CAGR and a large adjusted-vs-GAAP gap.

name: La-Z-Boy Incorporated
reason: Cyclical discretionary furniture with a 3.4% 10y revenue CAGR, EBIT margin range-bound at 7-9% and no moat or secular driver.

name: S&T Bancorp, Inc.
reason: Ordinary western-Pennsylvania community bank with consensus FY2-3 EPS growth of only 1.4-2.6%, a rising share count (+1.2%/yr) and a 2020 credit hit (-81% EPS).

name: Suburban Propane Partners, L.P.
reason: Propane distributor with flat revenue (0.1% 10y CAGR), weather- and commodity-driven earnings, structurally declining volumes and net debt/EBITDA 4.8x.

name: FTI Consulting, Inc.
reason: Leading restructuring/litigation/economic consulting franchise with a counter-cyclical mix, 17% 10y EPS CAGR, shares down 2.4%/yr from buybacks (85% of FCF), net debt/EBITDA 0.8x and consensus FY2-3 growth of 17%/11%; key risks are senior-talent retention and AI pressure on the Technology segment.

name: Verizon Communications Inc.
reason: Mature wireless oligopolist with a 1.7% 10y EPS CAGR, net debt/EBITDA 3.3x before the Frontier deal and capex-heavy competition, so 7%+ EPS growth is implausible.

name: Park National Corporation
reason: Conservatively run Ohio bank, but EPS is at its 10y peak (1.0x) after a NIM tailwind and consensus FY2-3 growth is only ~2.5%, so there's no plausible route to 7%+ and no specialness at 13.4x.

name: Covista Inc.
reason: Formerly Adtalem: EPS has compounded 22.6% over 5y, but margins sit at 100th-percentile highs, growth came partly from the Walden acquisition (acq/FCF 1.15) and Title IV/graduate-loan-cap rules pose a credible regulatory threat.

name: BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc.
reason: Rare-disease biotech that only recently turned profitable (EBIT margin -37% in 2015 to 27.5%), with earnings dependent on Voxzogo facing new achondroplasia competitors and pipeline/M&A outcomes that are binary.

name: Chevron Corporation
reason: Integrated oil major whose earnings are set by oil and gas prices (EPS ranged -0.20 to 18.83 over 10y, only 3/10 years of >=7% growth).

name: KB Home
reason: Homebuilder whose earnings track the housing and mortgage-rate cycle (EBIT margin 4.5-15.3%, FY1 consensus -48%) and can't be forecast 5-10 years out.

name: F.N.B. Corporation
reason: Acquisition-built regional bank with shares up 7.5%/yr over 10y, so a 14.3% revenue CAGR became only 6.2% EPS growth, with 10y avg ROE of just 7.6%.

name: SiriusXM Holdings Inc.
reason: Satellite radio in secular subscriber decline against streaming, EBIT margin at the 18th percentile of history, net debt/EBITDA 3.9x and a 2024 goodwill write-down (EPS -6.14).

name: Gibraltar Industries Incorporated
reason: Recently transformed portfolio (renewables exit plus roofing-accessory and other acquisitions, acq/FCF 0.63) with margins at the 100th percentile of history and agtech/infrastructure project lumpiness.
